lines: Maulid Birthday of the Prophet and Christmas Together 2015 Welcome to our service for Christmas Eve 2015 and celebration of Maulid of the Prophet Muhammad SAW. The birth and overcoming of life over nothingness. And this year we are thankful that Christmas fell at the time and date very close to the Maulid Nabi.

Both days of birth, the birth of two very important people from the two of the biggest religions in the world And, we all know that together these two religions are two religions which are often clashing. History has proven that for thousands of years Christianity and Islam have a relationship that is more often drenched in blood than drenched in wine, food and beverages like tonight.

And tonight perhaps we can begin a new history where the celebration of Christmas is combined with Maulid. And of course this is not just a gimmick or a pretense, but we hope that it is a true relationship between all of you who are Muslims and Christians. There is one true statement that we are concerned about, that the world is becoming worse.

The most divine God/Allah who is true Has come down to humanity Allah himself in the shape of Isa Worship and praise him Oh Your God Allah the Prophet Peace be upon you Rosul Peace be upon you My beloved Peace be upon you Brothers and Sisters, each time we remember the story of Christmas, there is often a question?

Why did God/Allah become man? Some people may think that this is not rational. . Some others may think for what? Still others may transfixed with that belief and see themselves as superior to others because they believe that. These different attitudes actually depend on how we understand Allah/God.

There are some people who understand Allah/God as an old figure with a white beard who sits above in the clouds Those from there interfere in history from time to time for the fulfillment of everyday we nevertheless never react in the important moments in history. Nevertheless figures like that precisely are not unmoved when Marsinah was murdered, or when WidjiThukul was lost without a trace.

Or when thousands of Indonesians were victims of the bloody tragedy fifty years ago. Toward a Allah/God like this sane people may think for what did Allah become human? Why just now? Why only once? Something dragging [???}, but that is not the story that we see of God/Allah in the story of Christmas.

In the story of the baby Jesus who was born on that Holy Night, we see the picture of God who embraces man in adversity in the midst of isolation and anxieties.
